title: Lantern and Atlas
author: Wren Nystrom
blurb: Rafael Underhill, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
